feature_contract.goal: Repair stale UI/vehicle-selection DDS sprite scale when a previously replaced xstset slot reloads the original texture, preserving original headers, active slot state and native/fast decoder fallback.
acceptance_items: A successful unmodified/original UI DDS reload clears an older replacement scaling ratio in both fast allocator and original D3DX allocators.
A valid selected replacement preserves its new scale; failed decoder restores game header/old scale and failed original retry keeps prior live slot untouched.
Per-method destructive mutations and negative/positive UI DDS loader and visual composition checks pass without weakening scene textures, game input, original D3D9 fallbacks.
Final exact-SHA Win32 x86 game and x64 OpenXR host/full-chain/package plus Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector, and Full Source Impact all succeed.

runtime_evidence: No matching OutRun 2006 / Quest3 / VDXR actual runtime test was performed; no visual, FPS, or headset PASS claimed.
